errors.operator_only: {what} is shared by every workspace, so only the operator may {verb} it. Set {env} to the workspace that administers this install and use an admin credential from it.
errors.other_workspace: caller is scoped to a different workspace
errors.task_workspace_undetermined: cannot determine the task's workspace: link a project, create it on a board, or pass ?workspace=
errors.projects_span_workspaces: linked projects belong to different workspaces ({first}, {second}): pass ?workspace= to choose
errors.run_task_scope: an agent run's key may only change its own task, its parent and sibling/child subtasks, and tasks its task created
errors.run_flag_decision: deciding or removing an approval (or a flag) is a person's call: an agent run can ask for one, not approve it
errors.run_question_decision: answering or canceling an agent's question is a person's call: an agent run asks, it does not answer
errors.run_thread_decision: applying or resolving a thread is a person's call: an agent run answers in threads, it does not close them
errors.run_conversation: the task's conversation is the person's side: an agent run answers there, it does not speak for them
errors.run_cannot_open_chats: an agent run cannot open chats
errors.run_own_chat_only: an agent run's key reaches only its own chat
errors.run_chat_read_only: an agent run may read its chat, not write to it: a message there is the person speaking
errors.run_transcripts_scope: an agent run's key may only read the transcripts of runs on the tasks it may change
errors.run_github_confirmation: these routes carry a delegated chat's merge or deployment review to the person it acts for; an agent run on a task merges and approves with its own GitHub tools
errors.run_merge: an agent run cannot merge a task branch or upload a project's code; a person does that from the dashboard
errors.run_evidence_scope: an agent run's key may read Evidence but not change it: environments, secrets, cases and batches are a person's to edit. A recording chat saves its take with the recording tools
